title: introduce intake-lineage-manifest + sparse changelog assembler
author: Maya Chen
description: Problem / Motivation: onboarding artifacts and changelogs for model intake lacked a compact, verifiable lineage and the changelog generator produced noisy, large release notes for minor metadata deltas. This PR adds a lineage-backed intake manifest that records the minimal dependency graph for a model intake (datasets, preprocessing transforms, provenance blobs) and a sparse changelog assembler that serializes only semantic deltas with optional deterministic sampling for example snippets. Goals: 1) provide a deterministic provenance signature for each intake manifest to make downstream release artifacts auditable; 2) shrink per-release changelogs by deduplicating metadata-only churn and emitting impact-first lines; 3) make the system usable from both the onboarding CLI and the web curation UI. What this PR changes (summary): - New intake manifest format: x-manifest-v2.json (compact DAG of blobs + semantic labels + stable fingerprint). - Signer: ed25519-based signing utility and service-side verification hook (sdk + server). - Sparse changelog assembler: takes two manifests and emits a compact human-friendly changelog with categories (perf, safety, infra, metadata) and sample-level diffs. - CLI: new command `rw model intake diff-changelog --from v1 --to v2 --sample 50` that produces compact drafts for release notes. - Backend: integration hook to store manifest->signatures in the registry and surface changelog drafts to the curator workflow. Design notes: - Lineage manifest is intentionally normalized: nodes reference content blobs by content-hash (sha256) and include a small typed label set (dataset, tokenizer, quantization-profile, eval-set). This keeps manifests small and mergeable. - Signatures are detached (manifest + signature) to allow offline signing for private deployments; verification performed by registry on upload. - Changelog assembler uses a three-way heuristic: structural diff (added/removed nodes), semantic diff (field-level important changes), and sample delta (deterministic sampling by hash + optional sampling seed). Implementation highlights (commits): - consumption and validation logic in intake-service (intake/manifest/validator.py) - signing client + key rotation shim (tools/signing/*) - changelog assembler library (registry/changelog/assembler.py) - CLI plumbing and web integration (cli/rw_model.py, web/curation/hooks.py) Tests and quality: - unit tests for manifest canonicalization and signature verification - integration tests for end-to-end manifest upload + changelog generation - small load test that exercises changelog generation on 500 manifests to check worst-case memory usage Backward compatibility & migration: - manifests are versioned (v1/v2); v1 manifests are accepted but will be auto-promoted to v2 via a normalization pass during intake if possible. - The signer is optional; uploads without signature will be accepted but marked as unsigned and gated for enterprise policies. Rollout plan: 1) Merge feature behind feature-flag 'lineage-manifest' 2) Deploy signing service to staging and run calibration jobs on pre-existing manifests 3) Enable changelog drafts for curators in small cohort 4) Gradual enablement for all accounts Risks and mitigations: - Key management: keys are rotated and stored in KMS; tooling provides a simulated KMS for dev. - Large manifests: normalization prunes noise (unchanged auxiliary metadata) and limits sample size by default. Related work: ENG-1986 (lineage infra), ENG-2073 (changelog UX). Checklist: - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests - [x] docs for CLI (docs/cli/intake.md) - [x] migration script (tools/manifest_migrate.py) - [x] security review of signer logic - [x] add telemetry for changelog generation Usage example: `rw model intake upload --manifest x-manifest-v2.json --signature manifest.sig` Links: linear/ENG-1986, docs PR #349 in docs repo, internal runbook: runbooks/lineage-signing.md

release_notes:
- Add v2 intake manifest with deterministic lineage fingerprint and detached ed25519 signatures.
- New sparse changelog assembler emits compact release notes focusing on semantic deltas.
- CLI: `rw model intake diff-changelog` and upload with signature support.
- Migration helper included to normalize old manifests to v2.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated behind 'lineage-manifest'. Signing service requires KMS-backed key; see runbooks/lineage-signing.md for rotation and emergency revoke steps. Staging rollout validated by migration job that normalized ~12k manifests.
